story.title: [User Story] Report the parser version in the CLI help text
story.description:
As a user, I want `example --help` to name the parser version, so that a bug report says which parser produced it.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] AC1 `example --help` prints a line `parser <version>`, the version the package metadata declares.
- [ ] AC2 A unit test covers the line.

## Definition of Done

- [ ] All acceptance criteria met
- [ ] Independently reviewed
- [ ] Verified in a deployed environment (if needed)
